post.description: HEADs the uploaded object and verifies its actual size and content-type match the declared values. Returns 200 with {status} in either case: success → READY + ATTACHMENT_ADDED activity; mismatch or missing object → FAILED + reason (retry allowed). A mismatch is a state-machine outcome, NOT a 4xx — finalize must commit the FAILED status (an exception would roll it back; jpa_rollback_only_trap). Idempotent: already-READY → 200 READY. Only the uploader may finalize; a foreign PENDING row → 404.
